'''Peter Franke''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished Top 8 at [[2000 Bespin Regionals]] on 29 July 2000, according to Jim Li's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1058">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-30-bespin-regional-omaha-nebraskad1058/ bespin-regional-omaha-nebraska], DeckTech (Jim "Stimmed Jim" Li, 30 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-30-bespin-regional-omaha-nebraskad1058/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
